title: Require Domain Operation Source Topology
forbids: domain operation collections or operation roots outside the positive operation blueprint spine
why: The domain-operation blueprint owns operation collection and executable-leaf topology. The parent domain law only admits the operation slot and does not duplicate its internals.
remediate: Keep the required operation catalog and operation entrypoints, and retain only the explicitly admitted operation-local capabilities.
message: Domain operations must match the positive operation blueprint spine.
